column1: # BirdView's own occurrence status, derived from GBIF (P-001, CR-028).
# Generated by cmd/birdview-status. Not a copy of anything published.
# Status is recurrence, not abundance: a species is established where its
# records fall in repeated episodes across years, however few they are.
# Sources: EOD - eBird Observation Dataset, doi:10.15468/aomfnb, and the
# iNaturalist research-grade dataset. Both CC BY 4.0.
# Corpus ends 2026-09-20. A species last recorded before 2001-09-20 is historical,
# not present: GBIF carries museum specimens under their collection dates,
# and Passenger Pigeon recurs across a century of them.
